# Calendar year data from Table SN-1
# Amount outstanding at end of year
amount_1979 = 352  # million
amount_1980 = 300  # million  
amount_1981 = 269  # million

# Redemptions during the year
redemptions_1980 = 71  # million
redemptions_1981 = 51  # million

# Calculate average amount outstanding for each calendar year
# For 1980: average of 1979-end and 1980-end
avg_outstanding_1980 = (amount_1979 + amount_1980) / 2

# For 1981: average of 1980-end and 1981-end
avg_outstanding_1981 = (amount_1980 + amount_1981) / 2

print(f"Average amount outstanding 1980: {avg_outstanding_1980}")
print(f"Average amount outstanding 1981: {avg_outstanding_1981}")

# Calculate redemption rates as percentages
rate_1980 = (redemptions_1980 / avg_outstanding_1980) * 100
rate_1981 = (redemptions_1981 / avg_outstanding_1981) * 100

print(f"Redemption rate 1980: {rate_1980:.4f}%")
print(f"Redemption rate 1981: {rate_1981:.4f}%")

# Absolute difference in percentage points
abs_diff = abs(rate_1980 - rate_1981)
print(f"Absolute difference: {abs_diff:.4f} percentage points")

# Round to nearest hundredth (2 decimal places)
rounded = round(abs_diff, 2)
print(f"Rounded to nearest hundredth: {rounded}")
